_comment: Profile C: a Lua adapter that reads metadata over the source's REST API,
plus the vendor's JDBC driver registered with the database's loader for
the rows (the adapter pushes queries down as IMPORT FROM JDBC). Lua is
built into the database: no language container, nothing in BucketFS for
the adapter - its text goes into CREATE LUA ADAPTER SCRIPT.
The script is assembled from three parts: upstream's module preamble, the
dist file byte for byte (SHA-256 checked), and the kit's suffix
(lua/exakit_verified_tls.lua) carrying the pinned CA bundle. Measured on
Exasol Personal 2.3.0: the database's LuaSec loads no CA file or
directory, so the suffix verifies the REST API's certificate chain and
host name from memory instead of the upstream's verify_tls_certificate =
label: C
